title: Outfit Photo Logging Freshness
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:wardrobe source_name=* worn_epoch=* photo_logged_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((photo_logged_epoch-worn_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures outfit photo lag by capture source for outfit photo logging.
value: Lag tracking shows which capture source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside outfit photo logging.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `outfit photo lag` on `style:wardrobe` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of capture source with average and worst outfit photo lag.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how long things take for each capture source so you can see where outfit photo logging slows down.
